name: Flames of Sin's Fire hits from auto attacks stack Dawn (#12448)
contract: Dawn 705484 reads 'Dealing Fire damage now increases the damage dealt by Torchlight and Dusk Blade by
$503658s1% for $503658d, stacking $503658u times.' aura_ascension_witch_hunter_event::Check accepts any
outgoing damage with a Fire school mask for it. Flames of Sin 803422 makes each auto attack add 802850
'Flames of Sin: Deals Fire Damage.' (SchoolMask 4), but Check returned false for every outgoing spell in
Extra(), which lists 802850, so those Fire hits never reached Dawn and its buff 503658 never stacked from
them. Physical auto attacks alone must leave 503658 absent (control); with Flames of Sin on the Witch
Hunter, the 802850 hits that follow the swings must apply 503658. Ratings remove melee misses, dodges and
parries and the Fire hit's spell miss; the fixture dual-wields as in witch-hunter-flames-of-sin-auto-attack.

steps.label: Control: Physical auto attacks alone do not stack Dawn
Flames of Sin on the Witch Hunter
SETUP: an auto attack under Flames of Sin is followed by a Fire hit
DISCRIMINATING: the Flames of Sin Fire hit stacks Dawn
